name: Sidestep the base
description: Move the base sideways by a signed distance (left positive) without turning, also while carrying a load; aligns the arm with a target that is a little to the side.

verifier.name: sidestepped
verifier.meaning: Base moved sideways by the signed distance (left > 0) within 3 cm, heading unchanged within 3 deg.
verifier.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

policy_plan.selection: first path whose noun conditions all hold, decided before any motion
policy_plan.on_no_match: NO_PATH: the Contract refuses without moving

paths.note: Checked over the whole robot; a load stays held and the base drives slower.

relations.when: the object is now in front of the arm

failure.automatic_fallback: nested calls only: a failed precondition with a matching repair fallback runs the repair once and retries; top-level calls stop
